cancel.description: Starts asynchronous cancellation on a long-running operation. The server makes a best effort to cancel the operation, but success is not guaranteed. If the server doesn't support this method, it returns `google.rpc.Code.UNIMPLEMENTED`. Clients can use Operations.GetOperation or other methods to check whether the cancellation succeeded or whether the operation completed despite cancellation. On successful cancellation, the operation is not deleted; instead, it becomes an operation with an Operation.error value with a google.rpc.Status.code of `1`, corresponding to `Code.CANCELLED`.

This method lists locations based on the resource scope provided in the ListLocationsRequest.name field: * **Global locations**: If `name` is empty, the method lists the public locations available to all projects. * **Project-specific locations**: If `name` follows the format `projects/{project}`, the method lists locations visible to that specific project. workerId.description: A string used to uniquely distinguish a worker within a TPU node.

port.description: The port of this network endpoint.

ipAddress.description: The IP address of this network endpoint.

NetworkEndpoint.description: A network endpoint over which a TPU worker can be reached.

acceleratorType.description: Required. The type of hardware accelerators associated with this node.

healthDescription.description: Output only. If this field is populated, it contains a description of why the TPU Node is unhealthy.

schedulingConfig.description: The scheduling options for this node.

symptoms.description: Output only. The Symptoms that have occurred to the TPU Node.

name.description: Output only. Immutable. The name of the TPU

tensorflowVersion.description: Required. The version of Tensorflow running in the Node.

network.description: The name of a network they wish to peer the TPU node to. It must be a preexisting Compute Engine network inside of the project on which this API has been activated. If none is provided, "default" will be used.

labels.description: Resource labels to represent user-provided metadata.

ipAddress.description: Output only. DEPRECATED! Use network_endpoints instead. The network address for the TPU Node as visible to Compute Engine instances.

createTime.description: Output only. The time when the node was created.

cidrBlock.description: The CIDR block that the TPU node will use when selecting an IP address. This CIDR block must be a /29 block; the Compute Engine networks API forbids a smaller block, and using a larger block would be wasteful (a node can only consume one IP address). Errors will occur if the CIDR block has already been used for a currently existing TPU node, the CIDR block conflicts with any subnetworks in the user's provided network, or the provided network is peered with another network that is using that CIDR block.

apiVersion.description: Output only. The API version that created this Node.

enumDescriptions: Health status is unknown: not initialized or failed to retrieve.
The in-guest ML stack is unhealthy.
The node is under maintenance/priority boost caused rescheduling and will resume running once rescheduled.
health.description: The health status of the TPU node.

enumDescriptions: TPU node state is not known/set.
TPU node is being repaired and may be unusable. Details can be found in the `help_description` field.
TPU node has been preempted. Only applies to Preemptible TPU Nodes.
TPU node has been terminated due to maintenance or has reached the end of its life cycle (for preemptible nodes).
TPU node has unknown state after a failed repair.
state.description: Output only. The current state for the TPU Node.

networkEndpoints.description: Output only. The network endpoints where TPU workers can be accessed and sent work. It is recommended that Tensorflow clients of the node reach out to the 0th entry in this map first.

useServiceNetworking.description: Whether the VPC peering for the node is set up through Service Networking API. The VPC Peering should be set up before provisioning the node. If this field is set, cidr_block field should not be specified. If the network, that you want to peer the TPU Node to, is Shared VPC networks, the node must be created with this this field enabled.

serviceAccount.description: Output only. The service account used to run the tensor flow services within the node. To share resources, including Google Cloud Storage data, with the Tensorflow job running in the Node, this account must have permissions to that data.

port.description: Output only. DEPRECATED! Use network_endpoints instead. The network port for the TPU Node as visible to Compute Engine instances.

description.description: The user-supplied description of the TPU. Maximum of 512 characters.

tensorflowVersion.description: The version for reimage to create.
